expectations.text: The workflow triggers on pull requests
expectations.evidence: The written ci.yml has `on: pull_request: branches: [main]` (plus push to main).

expectations.text: Failure of any quality gate fails the pipeline run
expectations.evidence: Lint, test and audit are plain `run` steps in one job: `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm audit --audit-level=high`. None uses `continue-on-error` or `|| true`, so any non-zero exit fails the job and the run.

expectations.text: Steps are ordered logically and cache or setup steps are sane
expectations.evidence: Order is checkout, setup-node (Node 22, npm cache, cache-dependency-path pointing at the generated package-lock.json), `npm ci`, lint, test, audit. The agent created a lockfile so `npm ci` and the cache work, and set `defaults.run.working-directory` to the subproject.

expectations.text: No secrets are hardcoded in the workflow
expectations.evidence: The workflow contains no tokens, passwords or keys. Its only expression is `${{ github.ref }}` in the concurrency group, and permissions are `contents: read`.
